description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android project, specifying a method for outputting log information and supporting chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system that can output log data to one or more targets, with support for chaining log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable exception.
